Class TopicRegistry

java.lang.Object
network.ike.docs.plugin.registry.TopicRegistry
public final class TopicRegistry extends Object
The generated topic registry: every AsciiDoc file under a scan root, parsed by TopicHeader, in the shape IKE-TOPIC-REGISTRY.md gives topic-registry.yaml: topics grouped into domains by the prefix of their id, each with the registry's field names (id, file, title, type, keywords, status, char-count, related, summary), then what a build can add on top: assemblies and plain files with their document attributes, the findings the headers raise, and a generation stamp. This is the registry's build-time revision: generated from the files on every run where, before it, the same registry was kept by hand at src/docs/asciidoc/topic-registry.yaml. Pure Java with no Maven dependency, so it is testable without a build; TopicRegistryMojo is the wiring around it.

    • scanFrom

      public static TopicRegistry.Scan scanFrom(Path root, Path rootFile) throws IOException
      Scan from one root file: the file and every .adoc file it reaches through include:: lines, followed recursively and resolved relative to the including file as the AsciiDoc preprocessor does. Files under the root that are not reached are left out. An include whose target cannot be resolved statically (an attribute reference, an absolute path, a URI, a path above the root) or that names a missing file is a finding; a target that is not an .adoc file (a diagram, a CSV) is passed over. Each file is read once, so an include cycle ends.
      Parameters:
      root - the scan root; registry paths are relative to it
      rootFile - the .adoc file to start from, under root
      Returns:
      the scan result
      Throws:
      IOException - if a file cannot be read
      IllegalArgumentException - if rootFile is not an .adoc file under root

    • model

      public static Map<String,Object> model(List<TopicRegistry.Scan> scans, Path base, Instant now)
      The registry as an ordered map, ready for YAML: the schema's keys first (registry-version, generated, topic-count, domains with their topics), then assemblies, other-files and findings. Topics are grouped by domain and sorted by id. A file path is relative to its root, prefixed with the root when several roots were scanned.
      Parameters:
      scans - the scanned roots
      base - the directory root paths are made relative to (the module base directory)
      now - the generation instant
      Returns:
      the registry model

    • yaml

      public static String yaml(Map<String,Object> model)
      Render the registry model as YAML in the registry's block style: two-space indent, sequences indented under their key, one scalar per line. Written directly rather than through SnakeYAML's emitter, which cost 40 percent of a large run and about 45 ms of class loading on every small one; the output round-trips through load(Path) unchanged.
      Parameters:
      model - the registry model from model(List, Path, Instant)
      Returns:
      the YAML text

    • add

      public static List<TopicHeader> add(Map<String,Object> model, Path base, List<Path> files, Instant now) throws IOException
      Add files to an existing registry, or refresh their entries, without rescanning the roots: each file is parsed alone, placed in its domain in id order, counted, and checked for a duplicate id against the ids the registry already holds. An entry for the same file is replaced, so a re-ingested document is safe to add again. Files the registry lists but that no longer exist are not noticed here; a full scan is.
      Parameters:
      model - the registry model, from model(List, Path, Instant) or load(Path); updated in place
      base - the module base directory the registry's roots are relative to
      files - the files to add, relative to base or absolute; each must be an .adoc file under one of the registry's roots
      now - the update instant, recorded as generated
      Returns:
      the parsed headers of the added files, in the order given
      Throws:
      IOException - if a file cannot be read
      IllegalArgumentException - if a file is missing, is not AsciiDoc, or lies under none of the registry's roots

Shared with idoc:diff, which generates the registry for each side of a comparison in this same shape.
